## What is new

- `archivist screen` finds companies by valuation ratios, size, returns and annual figures on the nightly snapshot, for example `archivist screen --industry mining --max pe=15 --min market_cap_usd_m=500`. It is also a tool in `archivist mcp serve`.
- `archivist filings --min-reaction-z 2` lists only the filings around which the share moved at least that many standard deviations. Each filing row now carries the measured move.
- Pairing shows the Mosaic account the code belongs to and asks you to confirm before anything is saved. Where no terminal can answer, a Mosaic page in this computer's browser confirms it.
- The installer asks one question: "Start Archivist when your computer starts? (recommended)".
- Pause and Resume, in the Mosaic workspace and with `archivist connect --pause` and `archivist connect --resume`.
- A new browser is trusted once, in one step, before it can drive this computer.
- "Allow for session" now covers the command or the file you allowed, not the whole tool.
- Mosaic tools never ask for approval, in any mode.
- On Linux, Claude Code sessions need two packages, `bubblewrap` and `socat` (for example `sudo apt install bubblewrap socat`). The installer and `archivist connect --check` say when either is missing.
- `archivist connect` needs Claude Code 2.1.299 or newer, or Codex 0.163.0 or newer.
- Downloads are checked against signed checksums by the installers and by `archivist update`.

## Updating from v0.2.34

Run the install command again. Do not use `archivist update` for this update.

macOS and Linux:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://github.com/mosaicss/archivist/releases/latest/download/install.sh | bash
```

Windows (PowerShell):

```powershell
& ([scriptblock]::Create((irm https://github.com/mosaicss/archivist/releases/latest/download/install.ps1)))
```

A Homebrew install updates with `brew upgrade`.

`ARCHIVIST_INSTALL_VERSION` accepts v0.2.35 or later.

Computers on v0.2.34 or older keep working with the Mosaic workspace for two weeks after this release. After that they need this update.
